data.title: 不知火舞 · 折扇轻掩的火炎香气
data.action: 侧身斜倚在日式雕花榻榻米围栏上，单手用红白折扇半遮朱唇，红绳束起的棕发高马尾垂至后背，媚眼如丝，傲人身段在轻纱下呼之欲出。
data.location: 不知火流古风和室道场内庭，庭院石灯笼在樱花树下散发暖红火光
data.timeOfDay: 春夜忍术修习后的月下微凉
data.lighting: 庭院石灯笼的暖红火苗投射出流动的光影，与银亮月光交织，将肌肤衬得如凝脂般诱人
data.camera: three quarter view, low angle, medium shot
data.mood: 格斗女王的极致艳丽与致命诱惑，传统日式忍道美人的热烈狂野
data.description: 不知火流古风和室道场内庭，庭院石灯笼在樱花树下散发暖红火光。侧身斜倚在日式雕花榻榻米围栏上，单手用红白折扇半遮朱唇，红绳束起的棕发高马尾垂至后背，媚眼如丝，傲人身段在轻纱下呼之欲出。 她微微抬眸轻语——“安迪总是像个木头人……那么你呢？在不知火流的女忍面前，你的眼睛能从我身上移开吗？”
data.promptProse: Reclining sideways against the carved wooden veranda railing of the Shiranui dojo tatami room at night, Mai wears a scarlet silk halter dudou nightgown laced at the sides with gold cords and sheer high-slit panels. Lifting an open red-and-white folding fan to veil her lips, she gazes down with playful sultry confidence as cherry blossom petals drift through the courtyard air. Warm red glow from a garden stone lantern blends with cool silver moonlight over her curves.
data.animaCaption: Reclining against the tatami veranda railing in her scarlet silk halter dudou nightgown with sheer high-slit panels, Mai partly hides her lips behind a folding fan and gives a sultry gaze. Warm stone lantern glow and moonlight mix among drifting cherry blossoms.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a scarlet silk open-back halter dudou nightgown tied at the waist with fine gold cords and flowing into sheer high-slit side panels.
